title: Vorticity moments and three-dimensional feedback
purpose: Test which vorticity-production and transverse-variance terms diagnose failure of an autonomous two-dimensional mean model, using matched simulations and exact two-dimensional three-component nulls.
physical_choice: Deep-water monochromatic Stokes drift. UE0=-alpha us_ref and UL0=(waves-alpha)us_ref, so q0=-alpha us_ref_prime remains explicit, including wave-off controls. A documented body force cancels native viscous decay of the prescribed laminar Lagrangian background; perturbations evolve freely.
experiments: 15 central runs: Re_lambda=100, 200, 300 and initial y-dependent perturbation energy / y-independent in-plane eddy energy ratios 0, 1e-8, 1e-6, .01, 1.
6 background-vorticity runs: alpha=.5 and 1 at Re_lambda=300, each with exact 2D, tiny and finite transverse disturbances.
6 wave-off controls at Re_lambda=100 and 300, retaining the same initial Eulerian q0.
2 exact y-independent three-component nulls with nonzero v, with and without waves.
3 refined-grid runs, 1 half-timestep finite-disturbance run, and 3 second-seed runs at the central Re_lambda=300 setting.
diagnostics: Global and height-resolved Eulerian-q and anomaly enstrophy, native rates, signed and absolute production, transverse-mean/variance exchange, and transport fluxes.
Native split/chain-rule checks are separated from continuum spatial-product residuals and finite-time quadrature error.
Mean velocity comparisons and maps retain the matched 2D reference; three-dimensional energy alone is not a closure criterion.
limits: Finite-time 1200 s experiments; no asymptotic or universal stability threshold is assumed.
Re_lambda=U_2D_initial*lambda/nu; adding transverse perturbations adds energy. These are matched-background comparisons, not equal-total-energy comparisons.
The q0 gradient produces anomaly enstrophy even in exact 2D; this is distinct from the three-dimensional term T.
T=0 is necessary for y-independent motion but does not prove a field is two-dimensional; signed averages can cancel.
The 2D3C nulls have v nonzero and all y derivatives zero: tests must not require v=0.
Only the central Re_lambda=300 triad has a second seed and spatial refinement; other cells are single realizations.
The fine grid also halves MAX_DT for stability; the separate baseline-grid half-step run isolates timestep sensitivity for finite disturbances.
The variable wave-induced shear and bounded depth do not inherit a universal Rossby threshold from rigid rotation.

storage.estimated_uncompressed_GiB: 15-20, excluding transient checkpoints and validation scratch; persistent archives compressed
storage.public_output: Global moment statistics, summaries, sampled mean profiles and plots; full native fields and 1 s height profiles remain private
